title: Review independence becomes a preference, and posting survives a bad diff
summary: Two threads run through this change. First, builder-family detection gets broader and more honest: `family_of` now matches any word of a `Code-Generator:` trailer (so `Anthropic Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5` and `Claude Sonnet 5.5` both read as anthropic), a name whose words disagree is `unknown`, and `detect_detailed` reports per-commit reasons without ever echoing trailer text. A clean merge with no trailer is exempt via a new `git::is_clean_merge` that merges parents in a scratch object store. Second, independence stops being a hard gate: when the builder family is unknown or every reviewer shares it, the first configured reviewer runs anyway and the run says independence was not achieved, with `not_run` recorded on skipped reviewers. On the posting side, `review::DiffLines` parses `gh pr diff` so findings outside the diff go into the body instead of failing the whole review with HTTP 422, and oversized bodies are cut and counted rather than refused.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: commands and orchestration
lanes.summary: The binary's entry points: `review run`, `review post`, and the shared post-planning path.

lanes.label: Review core
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf review modules
lanes.summary: Builder-family detection, reviewer setup and reduction, and review planning/posting.

lanes.label: Git layer
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/git.rs
lanes.summary: Thin wrappers over the git binary: commit ranges, messages, and the new clean-merge check.

lanes.label: External
lanes.subtitle: git and GitHub
lanes.summary: The git binary and the `gh` CLI, the only things this crate shells out to.

nodes.label: review run
nodes.subtitle: main.rs: run + --post-to
nodes.summary: Runs the roster over the selected lenses and, with `--post-to`, posts the outcome. Now routes posting through `plan_for_post`, which fetches the PR diff only when a finding could be inline.

nodes.label: review post
nodes.subtitle: main.rs: review_post_cmd
nodes.summary: Posts findings from a saved artifact. Now calls `plan_for_post` with the repo and PR number so the diff can be consulted.

nodes.label: plan_for_post
nodes.subtitle: findings + diff -> Plan
nodes.summary: Decides whether any finding could be an inline comment; only then fetches the diff. A refused diff becomes `DiffLines::unavailable()` and the review still posts.

nodes.label: plan_review_in_diff
nodes.subtitle: review.rs: verdict, body, comments
nodes.summary: Splits findings into anchored (inline) and unanchored (body). Unanchored findings go under 'Findings outside the diff' with their place named; the body is cut to `BODY_LIMIT` and the rest counted instead of refused.

nodes.label: DiffLines
nodes.subtitle: review.rs: parse / contains / unavailable
nodes.summary: Parses a unified diff's hunk headers into per-file right-side line ranges, so a finding can be checked against the lines GitHub will accept a comment on.

nodes.label: fetch_diff
nodes.subtitle: gh pr diff --repo
nodes.summary: Shells out to `gh pr diff` and parses the result. Errors are surfaced so the caller can fall back to body-only placement.

nodes.label: build_advisory_payload
nodes.subtitle: advisory prefix counts against limit
nodes.summary: The advisory prefix now counts against `BODY_LIMIT`; an overflowing body is cut on a character boundary, keeping the trailing 'more findings' line when present.

nodes.label: family_of
nodes.subtitle: builder.rs: any word decides
nodes.summary: Matches every whitespace- and slash-separated word of a model name against aliases then `agents::MODEL_FAMILIES`. A name whose words point to different families is `unknown` rather than guessed.

nodes.label: detect_detailed
nodes.subtitle: builder.rs: families + unknown reasons
nodes.summary: Walks commits oldest-first, skipping clean merges with no trailer, and returns the distinct families plus one fixed-cause reason per unknown commit. `detect` is now a thin wrapper.

nodes.label: MODEL_FAMILIES
nodes.subtitle: agents.rs: shared prefix table
nodes.summary: The shipped prefix table moved here and widened: vendor names (`anthropic`, `openai`, `google`) and `codex` now match, and the table is the single source `builder::family_of` reads.

nodes.label: setup / choose_fallback
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs: independence fallback
nodes.summary: Detects builder families, then picks a fallback when no reviewer can be shown independent: the first runnable reviewer runs, the rest sit out with `ONLY_FIRST_RUNS`, and the note says independence was not achieved.

nodes.label: ReviewerRun.not_run
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs: why a reviewer sat out
nodes.summary: A new optional field records why a reviewer made no attempt, so an empty attempt list no longer reads as 'looked at, clean'. Populated from `skip_reason` and `family_error`.

nodes.label: left_out_notes / unknown_detail
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs: summary notes
nodes.summary: Builds the notes appended to the posted summary: the independence note first, then one line per skipped reviewer. `unknown_detail` names up to three commits and counts the rest.

nodes.label: commit_hashes / commit_message
nodes.subtitle: git.rs
nodes.summary: Existing helpers the builder detection walks over; unchanged but now called per commit rather than once for the whole range.

nodes.label: is_clean_merge
nodes.subtitle: git.rs: merge-tree --write-tree
nodes.summary: A merge is clean when it has exactly two parents, `merge-tree --write-tree` merges them without conflict, and the resulting tree equals the merge commit's own tree. Fails closed on old git, conflicts and extra parents.

nodes.label: merge_tree_in_scratch_store
nodes.subtitle: git.rs: read-only-safe merge
nodes.summary: Runs `merge-tree` with `GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY` pointed at a temp dir and the repo's objects as an alternate, so a read-only checkout is never written to. Cleans up the scratch dir afterwards.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: rev-list, rev-parse, merge-tree
nodes.summary: The git binary. `merge-tree --write-tree` needs git 2.38 or newer; older git makes every trailerless merge count as unknown.

nodes.label: gh
nodes.subtitle: pr view, pr diff, api
nodes.summary: The GitHub CLI. `pr diff` is the new call; it can fail with HTTP 406 on a very large diff, which the planner treats as 'no inline placement'.

edges.label: --post-to
edges.summary: `review run --post-to` now plans through the diff-aware path.

edges.label: repo + pr
edges.summary: `review post` passes the repo and PR number so the diff can be fetched.

edges.label: only if inline candidate
edges.summary: The diff is fetched only when some finding could be an inline comment; a failure degrades to body-only placement instead of aborting the post.

edges.label: unified diff
edges.summary: The raw diff text is parsed into right-side line ranges.

edges.label: findings + diff
edges.summary: The planner hands the parsed diff to `plan_review_in_diff`, which decides inline versus body per finding.

edges.label: contains(path, line)
edges.summary: Each finding's path and line is checked against the diff's right side.
The plan's body feeds the advisory payload when the self-review fallback fires.

edges.label: detect_detailed
edges.summary: Setup now reads the detailed result so it can build the unknown-builder note and the fallback.

edges.label: per trailer name
edges.summary: Each trailer's model name is mapped through `family_of`.

edges.label: prefix table
edges.summary: The shipped table is now read from `agents::MODEL_FAMILIES` instead of a private copy.

edges.label: skip trailerless merges
edges.summary: A commit with no trailer is skipped only when `is_clean_merge` says it introduces nothing of its own.
Commit hashes and messages come from the existing git helpers.
The actual merge runs in a scratch object store so a read-only checkout is safe.

edges.label: merge-tree --write-tree
edges.summary: Runs `git merge-tree --write-tree` with the scratch object directory set.

edges.label: rev-list --parents
edges.summary: Reads the commit's parents and tree before merging.

edges.label: fallback + skip reasons
edges.summary: The reduce step reads the setup's fallback and skip reasons to build the summary notes.

edges.label: not_run
edges.summary: Each reviewer run records why it sat out, or nothing when it ran.

views.title: Review posting path
views.summary: How a run's findings become a GitHub review: the planner decides whether the diff is needed, the diff decides which findings can be inline, and the body absorbs the rest.

views.title: Builder-family detection
views.summary: How a reviewed range's commits become a set of builder families, and how a trailerless clean merge is told apart from one that carries work.
